decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the use of the vehicular crossover.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 4 - The front boundary wall, of no greater than 600mm in height shall be reinstated except at point of access and the proposed railings shall be of a design and spacing to allow adequate visibility.
Condition : 5 - The proposed gates shall be inward opening only and shall not open across the footpath
description: Installation of a vehicular crossover to dwellinghouse.
